title: Raja Ravi Varma's birth chart
metaDescription: Raja Ravi Varma's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 9.0° Taurus. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Aries — Mercury, Venus, Uranus and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 9.0° Taurus. That falls in the first decan, 0°–10°, sub-ruled by Venus in the classical scheme — a earth sign read through a fixed season.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Mercury holds 18.8° Aries, Venus holds 16.4° Aries, Mars holds 6.6° Cancer — in the old shorthand, a mind that decides at speaking speed; taste that runs toward the vivid and the immediate; drive that moves on certainty and current.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Mercury to Uranus, a conjunction with 0.6° of slack. A conjunction is the least negotiable aspect in the scheme — no distance to argue across, so the pair arrives as a single instinct. Behind it, Venus square Jupiter at 1.6°, and Mercury conjunction Venus at 2.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, three sit in a sign it has an opinion about. Venus in Aries at 16.4° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Cancer at 6.6° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Jupiter in Cancer at 14.8° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 5 in water, 4 in fire, 1 in earth by element, 6 cardinal, 3 mutable, 1 fixed by modality. Water weights a chart toward the felt and the remembered — information that arrives as atmosphere before it arrives as words. No settled placement falls in air — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. The day carried no retrograde motion at all; everything moved forward as seen from here.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.2° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 12.7°.
